blocks.x: Reinsurance & Commercial Lines: the operating units, priority programs and the five capability towers that matter most here.

The workflows we industrialize here: Bordereaux intake/reconciliation, Treaty settlement, Retro/capacity optimization, Specialty underwriting, Broker submissions triage. Each arrives with its current cycle times measured in the Diagnose phase, and each leaves the program governed by outcome SLOs rather than anecdotes.

items: Ceded premium/loss bordereaux arrive in formats and qualities; reconciliation consumes analysts and hides data quality issues.
Retro programs and cat capacity buying are combinatorial; incumbent methods stop early.
Treaty settlement disputes rest on each party's numbers; evidence chains are procedural.
Specialty risks priced on judgment with variable evidence; appetite drifts by desk.
Sensitive exposure data exchanged by email/portal; confidentiality depends on culture.
Vendor cat models integrate by file drops; portfolio views lag.
